whyItMatters: A program can work on ten items and fail on ten million. Complexity helps predict growth; measurement checks the real workload.
simpleExplanation: Big-O describes how resource growth changes as input grows. A set lookup is commonly a better membership choice than repeatedly scanning a list, but correctness, memory, order, and actual data size still matter.
mentalModel: Complexity is a road map of how a journey grows when the city gets larger; benchmarking is driving the actual route today.
